pages.text: Those who work among the dead carry their own arms. Each strikes at its own pace: the $(l)Bone Saw$() quick and light, the $(l)Gravedigger's Spade$() steady and long, the $(l)Censer Flail$() slow and crushing.
Use it on a corpse to take it apart: bones, and often $(4)Pestilent Ichor$(), more from older bodies. The body is gone, but the sawing is filthy work; wear the garb.
Reaches a block and a half further than a blade. Use it on a corpse to bury it where it lies: it will never rise. Gravediggers sometimes drop their own.
Every blow is a burst of holy smoke that clears $(2)miasma$() and $(2)vermin clouds$() around its target, and it strikes Miasma Wraiths twice as hard.
